title: Role picker panels
description: Members can pick up (and drop) roles with buttons or from a menu: name colours, notifications, games, teams. After editing, refresh the posted panel with the “Refresh” button.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.hint: Every role has its own button — one click: on, another: off.

menu.name: Dropdown menu
menu.hint: One button opens a pre-filled list just for the member — handier for many roles.

free.name: Free choice
free.hint: Any number of roles — click to add, click again to remove.

unique.name: Only one (swap)
unique.hint: Only one role at a time — a new one replaces the previous one (e.g. name colour).

limit.name: At most N
limit.hint: At most this many roles from the panel at a time.

add_only.name: Add only
add_only.hint: Can be added, but not removed on the panel (e.g. accepting the rules).

final.name: Final choice
final.hint: You can choose one, and the choice is final (e.g. picking a team).

remove_only.name: Remove only
remove_only.hint: The role can only be removed on the panel (e.g. unsubscribing).

problems.everyone: @everyone can’t be put on a panel
problems.managed: this role is managed by an integration (bot, Booster, Twitch …)
problems.aboveBot: it’s higher than the bot’s role — drag the bot’s role above it (Server Settings → Roles)
problems.aboveYou: it’s higher than your own highest role

emptyText: Create one: members can pick up roles with buttons or from a menu.
created: Panel created — now add the roles.
deleteText: The bot also removes the posted message. Roles already given stay with the members.
showList: List of roles on the card
showCounts: Member count next to the roles
savedPublish: Saved — refresh the posted panel below.
addRoleFirst: First add at least one role.
label: Label
emojiHint: A Unicode emoji or one of the server’s own emojis (<:name:id>) — this is shown on Discord.
entryRequired: Can only be taken with this role
message: Message when taken (only they see it)
noEntries: No roles on the panel yet.
